source.cross_check_result: identical: 66 prefixes / 60 suffixes, all mod ids, levels and spawn weights agree

affix_count_odds._note: Relative weights for how many affixes a freshly reforged item gets. Not present in GGG data files; taken from the two independent open-source crafting simulators that agree on it (kalandralang src/item.ml, PoeCraftLib StatFactory.cs).

notes: Normalise a rendered stat line by replacing every value_placeholder match with "#", then look the result up against match_lines[].match_string.
stats[].min/max are raw stat units. display_min/display_max are the same bounds after index_handlers, i.e. the units printed in the tooltip. Compare parsed rolls against display_min/display_max.
A tier can spawn iff item level >= required_ilvl.
GGG tier numbering: tier 1 is the highest required_ilvl in the group that can spawn on this base, counted regardless of the item's own item level.
